title: Use a lighter
kid_text: Warm the lighter. A grown-up lights it.
safety: Point the flame away from your sleeve.

steps.text: Warm a cold lighter in your pocket.
Turn your back to the wind.
Spin the wheel with your thumb.
Hold the flame under the nest.
Add one thin stick at a time.

mistakes.text: The lighter is too cold to spark.
mistakes.fix: Warm it in a pocket first.

mistakes.text: You dump the whole pile on.
